title: Hybrid woman with skateboard in the grocery store

tellings.quote: this woman is walking in in front of me and I hit I'm hit by a brilliant It's one of them.

plain: In 2024, in a grocery store near Santa Monica, a woman carrying a skateboard walked in just ahead of the writer Whitley Strieber, and he says he was struck by a sudden, brilliant certainty that she was "one of them", a hybrid of human and alien. Strieber tells Michels this as something that happened to him. If he is right, beings who are part alien are already living ordinary lives among us.
